name: code-to-image
title: Code to Image
description: Render a code snippet as an image, online through codetoimage.com or locally with silicon.
author: black

commands.name: create-image
commands.title: Create Image
commands.subtitle: codetoimage.com
commands.description: Write or paste code, choose a language and theme, then render it online or locally and save the file.

preferences.name: renderer
preferences.title: Renderer
preferences.description: codetoimage.com renders online and supports PNG or SVG; silicon renders locally on this machine and only writes PNG.

preferences.name: saveFolder
preferences.title: Save Folder
preferences.description: Where rendered images are written. Supports ~; created if missing.
